info.title: FlakeHunter API
info.description: Ingests JUnit XML reports and reports flaky tests. A test is flaky on a commit when it has both a pass and a fail (or error) on the same commit SHA. Every error uses the same body: `{ error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`. Lists take `?limit=&offset=` and return `{ data, page: { limit, offset, total } }`.

uploadToken.description: A per-repository upload token. It identifies the repository; the request cannot name one.

get.description: Flake rate = flaky SHAs / SHAs run in the window (skipped results ignored). Only tests with at least minRuns SHAs and one flaky SHA appear, most flaky first. repo is owner/name or a numeric id.
Windowed totals for a repository. lastRunAt ignores the window.

post.description: Authenticated with a per-repository upload token (not the read token); the repository comes from the token. Idempotent on (run id, attempt, report key): the first upload returns 201, a repeat returns 200 with the original counts. A SHA that contradicts an existing run is a 400. Unparseable bodies or reports with no testsuite are 422 (invalid_report) and store nothing. Rate limited per IP and per token (429 with Retry-After).

parameters.name: content-encoding
parameters.description: Only `gzip` is accepted. Any other encoding is a 400.

200.description: Duplicate upload; counts are those of the original.

schema.description: Duplicate upload; counts are those of the original.

requestBody.description: JUnit XML. Send it gzip-compressed with Content-Encoding: gzip for large reports (a Lambda request body is capped near 6 MB); the 11534336-byte limit applies to the decompressed size.

get.description: Paginated, ordered by full name. Use it to find a repository's numeric id.
The 50 most recent failed or errored results for a test, newest first, with run details. Not paginated; never includes failure stack traces.
Results for one test, newest first. Never includes failure stack traces.
